channel.title: Bhavitta guides
channel.description: Retirement guides for India, NRIs and FIRE, with every figure from Bhavitta's own engine.

item.title: Bhavitta vs a retirement calculator
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: A retirement calculator takes one return, applies it every year and tells you whether the money lasts. That is a useful first look, and on a real plan it is usually too optimistic. Here is the same plan run both ways, with what simulation adds and where a calculator is still the right tool.

item.title: Is ₹1 crore enough to retire in India?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: What ₹1 crore can pay each month if you stop at 45, 50, 55 or 60, what a small pension adds, and what each city's cost of living does to it. Every figure from the engine, in rupees.

item.title: Is ₹5 crore enough to retire in India?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: What ₹5 crore can pay each month if you stop at 35, 40, 45, 50 or 55, the chance it lasts on ₹1 lakh to ₹4 lakh a month, and which cities it works in. Every figure from the engine, in rupees.

item.title: What if the market crashes the year you retire?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: A 30% or 40% fall at 55, 60, 70 or 80, what each does to a ₹3.05 crore plan, and what gets it back on track. Every figure from the engine, in rupees.

item.title: Equity or debt after retirement: which makes the money last?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: The same couple on all-equity, balanced and conservative returns, at 45 and 55: the chance the money lasts, and what it takes to be nearly sure. Every figure from the engine, in rupees.

item.title: College, weddings, cars: how one-time costs change your corpus
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: A child's college, a wedding, two cars and home repairs, alone and together, and what each adds to the corpus a couple at 55 needs. Every figure from the engine, in rupees.

item.title: Is ₹3 crore enough to retire in India?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: The chance ₹2–6 crore lasts to 90, by monthly spending and the age you stop working, and how much you need for ₹75,000 to ₹2 lakh a month. Every figure from the engine, in rupees.

item.title: Moving back to India from the US: how much do you need?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: The dollar corpus a couple needs to retire in India at 45, 50 or 55, what a falling rupee does to it, and whether to keep the money in dollars. Every figure from the engine.

item.title: Health insurance in retirement: how much does it add to your corpus?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: What a premium rising 10% or 13% a year adds to the corpus you need at 45 or 55, and what it costs at 65, 75 and 85. Every figure from the engine, in rupees.

item.title: Which Indian city lets you retire earliest?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: The same couple, salary and savings in seven Indian cities, and the earliest age each lets them stop working. Every figure from the engine, in rupees.

item.title: Retire in a metro, then move: how much does a later move save?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: A couple retiring at 55 in Mumbai or Bangalore who move to a cheaper city at 60, 65, 70 or 75, and what each choice does to the corpus they need. Every figure from the engine, in rupees.

item.title: How much do you need to retire in India?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: The corpus a couple needs to retire at 45, 50 or 55 in seven Indian cities, with the chance it lasts to 90. Every figure from the engine, in rupees.

item.title: How the readiness score works
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: A plain-language walk through the simulation engine: what goes in, what the recurrence does each year, how the two return models differ, and exactly how the score, the survival rate and the "Ready at" age are computed.

item.title: Retirement planning in India, in rupees
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: What Bhavitta 2.9 models for a life lived in India: rupee returns, city costs and inflation, Indian tax slabs, EPF, PPF and NPS, a fixed EPS pension, gratuity and health insurance. The defaults, where they come from, and what is still missing.

item.title: Mumbai or Pune? Retiring in India at 55
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: One salaried couple, two cities, everything in rupees: EPF, PPF and NPS lock-ins, a fixed EPS pension, health premiums that outrun inflation, and Indian tax slabs. Every number from the engine.

item.title: Retire in Bangalore at 50, or stay in Seattle?
item.dc:creator: Balaji Gururajan
item.description: One couple, two timelines, every number from the engine. Historical replay and Monte Carlo side by side, and what actually moves the answer.
